This article compares "Indikator 14: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atriflimren, som udvikler iskæmisk apopleksi inden for 1 år" (Indicator 14: The proportion of newly diagnosed patients with atrial fibrillation who develop ischemic stroke within 1 year) across national, regional, and health cluster (sundhedsklynge) geographic entities in Denmark. The data evaluates the incidence of ischemic stroke among newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients within their first year of diagnosis [^src1].

### Targets Met and Missed
A striking finding across the dataset is that no geographic entity met the required standard. The "Standard opfyldt" (Standard met) column registers "0 (0)" for every single national, regional, and cluster-level entity, indicating a universal failure to meet the target threshold for this indicator [^src1]. Nationally, [[danmark|Danmark]] recorded 276 ischemic strokes out of 21,804 newly diagnosed patients, resulting in a current year proportion of 1.3% (95% CI 1.1-1.4) [^src1].

### Leaders and Trailers
At the regional level, [[region-sjaelland|Sjælland]] reported the highest proportion of stroke incidence at 1.5% (95% CI 1.1-2.0), while [[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] reported the lowest at 0.9% (95% CI 0.7-1.2) [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]] stood at 1.4%, [[region-syddanmark|Syddanmark]] at 1.3%, and [[region-nordjylland|Nordjylland]] at 1.2% [^src1].

Among the health clusters, the highest incidence rates (leaders) were observed in [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] and [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]], both at 1.9% [^src1]. They were followed by [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] and Klynge VEST at 1.8%, and [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] at 1.7% [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest rates (trailers) were recorded in [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] at 0.6%, [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] at 0.7%, and [[klynge-midt|Klynge MIDT]] at 0.8% [^src1]. Other low-performing clusters included [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]], [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]], and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]], all tied at 0.9% [^src1].

### Outliers
Certain clusters exhibit exceptionally wide confidence intervals, acting as statistical outliers due to small patient denominators. For instance, [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] reported a rate of 1.5% but with a 95% CI spanning from 0.3 to 4.4, based on only 3 events out of 195 patients [^src1]. Similarly, Klynge VEST reported 1.8% with a CI of 0.6-4.2, derived from just 5 events out of 274 patients [^src1].

### Trends
While the table includes columns for "Tidligere år" (previous years) showing historical counts and proportions—such as [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] dropping from a previous 2.3% to a current 1.6%, or [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] dropping from 1.4% to 1.0%—this data is drawn from a single dated section of the 2024 report [^src1]. Because a single dated section supports no broader trend claim across multiple independent report publications, these historical comparisons are limited to the snapshot provided within this specific document and cannot be used to establish multi-year reporting trends.
